utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — the community center is easiest. If you can, leave the lamp there, and hand tools would help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll drop the lamp at the community center and see if I can bring some hand tools too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it. That will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can check the power cable first. I’ll tell you if it’s firmly connected.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — please check that cable and let me know what you find. If it looks good, I’ll mark that task as handled.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m on it now — I’ll check the cable and report back right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send me the task list and who’s on each one, and I’ll slot people in fast.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll send the task list and roles right over, and I’ll check the school calendar again in case anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—keep me posted on any calendar shifts, and send the task list when you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a drill, hammer, tape measure, and a few screwdrivers if those would help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s great, Gus — I’ll add the drill, hammer, tape measure, and screwdrivers to the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Cleo — I’ll have them ready after 4, so just swing by when you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara—if you can help sort the donations and jot down what still needs fixing, I’ll have a clear list ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and make a clean list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara. That’ll make it much easier for me to keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I’ve still been hearing the repair drive is on today and getting good support. If I hear any last-minute updates, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — if anything changes, please send me the pickup list updates and any gaps in coverage so I can keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll keep an ear out and send you any pickup list updates or coverage gaps I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You bet — I’ll keep sending anyone who needs the repair drive location your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate that. If you hear the location details, send them my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll pass along the repair drive location as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a little fuzzy on the exact list, but I think we mostly need a few more tools and basic repair supplies. If you hear any updates, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll let you know if I hear any updates. If you can, send me the exact list when you have it so I can check the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — I’ll try to dig up the exact list and send it over when I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—just tell me what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free after 4 if that works for you. If you want, I can come by and help get things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive plan around, and I’ll make sure Dane hears it clearly too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — just send me the time and I’ll swing by a bit late to help with the starter fixes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll send you the time and keep the repair drive plan moving so everyone hears it clearly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any repair drive updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and point people to the signup info right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate you spreading the word while I’m out. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but I’ll check on the start time and what they still need. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — I’ll wait to hear back. If you find out anything else they need, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will — I’m checking now and I’ll pass along anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can help spread the word and connect folks. What’s the latest pickup list and are there any volunteer gaps I should know about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s still happening today. If you want, I can help confirm the pickup list and any volunteer gaps too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, Pia — I’ll help sort the pickup list and can pitch in with loading or delivery too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — please start with the pickup list, and then we can see if we still need more help for loading and delivery.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll start on the pickup list and let you know if I can take more on after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you want me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just help confirm the task list and who’s on each one, and I’ll slot people in fast.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll confirm the task list and who’s on each one right now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but last I heard it was probably still on for Saturday morning. If you’ve got the latest details, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’m still tracking the supplies, and we mainly need the basics first: tools, fasteners, and a few spare parts. If you hear of anything else, send it my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything else I hear. Hopefully we can keep the Saturday morning plan on track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone asking your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’d be glad to help, I just need a quick reminder of what I’m supposed to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren — just bring whatever tools you have handy, and if anyone asks, send them my way too!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’m ready to note the next repair drive location whenever you have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — if the school calendar stays clear, we’re still set for Saturday from 10 to 12. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’ve got Saturday from 10 to 12 noted, and I’ll keep track of any location updates too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can still make it if I come a bit late—just send me the time and I’ll swing by. I’m happy to start on the leaky faucets, loose outlets, and squeaky doors.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — that sounds really helpful. I’m still a bit fuzzy on the latest time, but I’ll pass it along if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — just let me know when you hear the time, and I’ll be there a bit late to help with the starter fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — the community center is still the best drop-off spot. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive plan around so everyone knows the community center is the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. The hand tools and a working lamp would help most if anyone can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — what still needs doing for the repair drive? I’ve got tools I can lend if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I’m still out running errands, but I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and let folks know if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira — thanks for keeping an ear out. Just let me know if you hear what tools or help are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle outreach and bring a toolkit. Just tell me where you want me first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Leo — I’ll put you on outreach and keep your toolkit in the mix. I’ll send you the latest list of needs first so you know where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send the list over and I’ll start with the first outreach need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — if you spot any tools, fasteners, or spare parts, send them my way and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Eli — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along any tools, fasteners, or spare parts I hear about right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep the list neat and make sure we stay on the basics.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m here and ready to keep the repair drive organized. What should I list or assign first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 9 a.m., and please bring any tools you have plus a can-do attitude.
